highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp 4.158.0 update improves mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads disagree.

bullets.lead: Handle changing glyph paths and mask layouts
bullets.detail: Mask-filtered glyph rendering respects the reloaded glyph's path, format and bounds. Incompatible or sub-byte masks produce cleared output, avoiding buffer overwrites and format assertions. Clipped embossed glyphs use full plane strides, and clearing the full destination prevents corrupted or uncleared mask planes.
